gaps.title: No water balance / irrigation model
gaps.description: Simulator only depletes soil moisture passively (0.02 * stress per day). No irrigation events, rainfall input, drainage, or runoff simulation. Cannot model water management scenarios.
gaps.current_behavior: Moisture monotonically decreases; no replenishment mechanism.
gaps.expected_behavior: Support irrigation scheduling, rainfall events, and water balance equations (e.g., FAO-56 crop evapotranspiration).
gaps.impact: Cannot evaluate irrigation strategies or drought response — core digital twin use case.

gaps.title: No nutrient cycling / fertilization model
gaps.description: Nutrient level is a static scalar (0-1) that only acts as a growth multiplier. No N-P-K dynamics, soil nutrient pools, mineralization, leaching, or fertilizer application events.
gaps.current_behavior: nutrient_level never changes during simulation.
gaps.expected_behavior: Dynamic nutrient pools with uptake, mineralization, leaching, and fertilization events.
gaps.impact: Cannot model fertilizer optimization or soil health degradation.

gaps.title: No pest / disease / weed pressure model
gaps.description: No biotic stress factors. Pest outbreaks, disease progression, and weed competition are absent from the simulation state and growth equation.
gaps.current_behavior: Only abiotic stress (temp, water, nutrient) affects growth.
gaps.expected_behavior: Pest/disease submodels with population dynamics, infection rates, and yield loss.
gaps.impact: Cannot simulate integrated pest management or disease outbreak scenarios.

gaps.title: No weather / climate data integration
gaps.description: Temperature is a fixed parameter. No diurnal cycles, seasonal variation, extreme weather events, or forecast integration.
gaps.current_behavior: Temperature constant throughout simulation.
gaps.expected_behavior: Time-varying weather driver (observed or forecast) with stochastic events.
gaps.impact: Cannot run realistic season-long simulations or climate scenario analysis.

gaps.title: No multi-crop or crop rotation support
gaps.description: Single crop height scalar. No crop type parameterization, phenological stages, or rotation effects on soil.
gaps.current_behavior: One-size-fits-all logistic growth with hardcoded parameters.
gaps.expected_behavior: Crop-specific parameter sets, phenological stage models, and rotation carryover effects.
gaps.impact: Cannot compare crop choices or model rotation benefits.

gaps.title: No yield prediction or harvest outcome
gaps.description: Simulation produces crop_height but no yield estimate, grain quality, or harvestable output.
gaps.current_behavior: total_growth is height difference only.
gaps.expected_behavior: Yield model (e.g., harvest index × biomass) with quality metrics.
gaps.impact: Cannot connect simulation to economic or supply-chain decisions.

gaps.title: No CO2 / photosynthesis model
gaps.description: No photosynthetic pathway (C3/C4), radiation use efficiency, or CO2 fertilization effect.
gaps.current_behavior: Growth is purely logistic with stress multipliers.
gaps.expected_behavior: Radiation-driven biomass accumulation with CO2 response curves.
gaps.impact: Cannot model climate change scenarios or greenhouse production.

gaps.title: No FAO-56 Penman-Monteith evapotranspiration calculation
gaps.description: Water balance model accepts ET as input but does not compute it from weather data. No crop coefficient (Kc) adjustment for different growth stages.
gaps.current_behavior: ET must be provided externally; no internal ET computation.
gaps.expected_behavior: FAO-56 dual crop coefficient method with Kcb, Ke, and Kc adjustment for climate and crop stage.
gaps.impact: Cannot run water balance from raw weather station data alone.

gaps.title: No multi-layer soil water model
gaps.description: Single bucket model with uniform soil moisture. No vertical water movement, root water uptake by depth, or layered soil horizons.
gaps.current_behavior: Single soil layer with one moisture value.
gaps.expected_behavior: Multi-layer model (e.g., 3-10 layers) with percolation between layers and depth-dependent root uptake.
gaps.impact: Cannot model deep percolation, root zone depletion profiles, or layered soil textures.

gaps.title: No soil water retention curve (van Genuchten)
gaps.description: Linear stress factor between wilting point and field capacity. No soil-type-specific water retention or hydraulic conductivity curves.
gaps.current_behavior: Linear interpolation for stress factor.
gaps.expected_behavior: Van Genuchten or Campbell curves parameterized by soil texture (sand, silt, clay fractions).
gaps.impact: Cannot accurately model water availability for different soil types.

gaps.title: No salinity / electrical conductivity tracking
gaps.description: No salt accumulation or leaching fraction modeling. Irrigation water quality not considered.
gaps.current_behavior: No salinity state variable or salt balance.
gaps.expected_behavior: Salt balance with irrigation water EC, leaching requirement, and salinity stress factor.
gaps.impact: Cannot model irrigation with brackish water or salinization risk.

gaps.title: No nitrification / denitrification split
gaps.description: Nitrogen mineralization is a single rate. No separate nitrification (NH4→NO3) and denitrification (NO3→N2/N2O) processes with environmental controls.
gaps.current_behavior: Single mineralization rate; no N species differentiation.
gaps.expected_behavior: Split N pool (NH4, NO3) with temperature/moisture-dependent nitrification and anaerobic denitrification.
gaps.impact: Cannot model N losses to atmosphere or nitrate leaching accurately.

gaps.title: No phosphorus sorption / desorption dynamics
gaps.description: P leaching is a simple first-order rate. No sorption isotherms, P fixation, or labile/stable P pool differentiation.
gaps.current_behavior: P leached at constant rate regardless of soil chemistry.
gaps.expected_behavior: Langmuir/Freundlich sorption with pH-dependent P availability and fixation.
gaps.impact: Cannot model P fertilizer efficiency or long-term P depletion.

gaps.title: No micronutrient modeling
gaps.description: Only N, P, K macronutrients tracked. No Zn, Fe, Mn, Cu, B, Mo, or other micronutrients.
gaps.current_behavior: Three macronutrients only.
gaps.expected_behavior: Micronutrient pools with deficiency thresholds and interactions.
gaps.impact: Cannot model micronutrient deficiencies common in high-yield systems.

gaps.title: No nutrient interaction / antagonism effects
gaps.description: Nutrient uptake is independent. No N×P×K interactions, cation exchange, or pH-dependent availability beyond a simple multiplier.
gaps.current_behavior: pH factor applied uniformly; no nutrient-nutrient interactions.
gaps.expected_behavior: Liebig's law of the minimum with interaction terms and CEC-based cation balance.
gaps.impact: Cannot model nutrient antagonism (e.g., high K inhibiting Mg uptake).

gaps.title: No organic matter decomposition dynamics
gaps.description: Organic matter is a static input. No C:N ratio-driven decomposition, humification, or residue incorporation.
gaps.current_behavior: organic_matter is constant; mineralization is a fixed fraction.
gaps.expected_behavior: Dynamic SOM pools (active, slow, passive) with C:N ratio controls on mineralization/immobilization.
gaps.impact: Cannot model cover crop residue effects or long-term soil health.

gaps.title: No PageRank / centrality algorithms
gaps.description: Knowledge graph has no node importance ranking. Cannot identify critical fields, crops, or sensors.
gaps.current_behavior: Only BFS path_exists and basic neighbor queries.
gaps.expected_behavior: PageRank, betweenness centrality, degree centrality, and eigenvector centrality.
gaps.impact: Cannot prioritize entities for monitoring, intervention, or resource allocation.

gaps.title: No community detection / clustering
gaps.description: No ability to discover functional clusters (e.g., field zones, crop groups, sensor networks).
gaps.current_behavior: No clustering or community structure analysis.
gaps.expected_behavior: Louvain, label propagation, or connected components for community detection.
gaps.impact: Cannot auto-discover management zones or functional modules in the farm graph.

gaps.title: No weighted shortest path (Dijkstra/A*)
gaps.description: path_exists uses unweighted BFS. No distance, cost, or time-based routing.
gaps.current_behavior: Binary path existence only; no path cost or optimal route.
gaps.expected_behavior: Dijkstra or A* with edge weights for logistics and routing.
gaps.impact: Cannot optimize machinery routes, irrigation flow, or supply chain paths.

gaps.title: No graph inference / rule-based reasoning
gaps.description: No transitive closure, rule engine, or inference capabilities. Cannot derive implicit relationships.
gaps.current_behavior: Only explicit relationships stored and queried.
gaps.expected_behavior: Rule-based inference (e.g., if A grows B and B produces C, then A indirectly_produces C).
gaps.impact: Cannot answer complex analytical questions or detect indirect risks.

gaps.title: No temporal / time-series graph queries
gaps.description: No support for temporal edges, historical state queries, or time-windowed graph analysis.
gaps.current_behavior: Graph is a static snapshot.
gaps.expected_behavior: Temporal graph with valid-time edges and historical traversal.
gaps.impact: Cannot analyze how relationships evolve or replay past states.

gaps.title: No subgraph pattern matching
gaps.description: No Cypher-like pattern matching or graph motif detection.
gaps.current_behavior: Simple property/relationship filters only.
gaps.expected_behavior: Pattern matching (e.g., find all field→crop→pest paths of length 3).
gaps.impact: Cannot express complex structural queries for decision support.

gaps.title: No Dijkstra / A* shortest path in graph_algorithms
gaps.description: graph_algorithms.py provides PageRank, community detection, and betweenness centrality but no weighted shortest path algorithm.
gaps.current_behavior: No shortest path computation available.
gaps.expected_behavior: Dijkstra or A* with edge weights for routing and logistics optimization.
gaps.impact: Cannot optimize machinery routes, irrigation flow, or supply chain paths.

gaps.title: No connected components algorithm
gaps.description: No weakly or strongly connected components detection. Cannot identify isolated subgraphs or disconnected farm zones.
gaps.current_behavior: No connected components computation.
gaps.expected_behavior: Tarjan's or Kosaraju's algorithm for SCC, and union-find for WCC.
gaps.impact: Cannot detect disconnected sensor networks or isolated field zones.

gaps.title: No eigenvector or degree centrality
gaps.description: Only PageRank and betweenness centrality implemented. No eigenvector centrality, degree centrality, or clustering coefficient.
gaps.current_behavior: Two centrality measures only.
gaps.expected_behavior: Eigenvector centrality, degree centrality, and local clustering coefficient.
gaps.impact: Limited options for different network analysis perspectives.

gaps.title: No integration between Graph and AgriKnowledgeGraph
gaps.description: graph_algorithms.py defines its own Graph class, completely separate from AgriKnowledgeGraph. No adapter or bridge exists.
gaps.current_behavior: Two independent graph implementations with no data flow.
gaps.expected_behavior: Adapter to convert AgriKnowledgeGraph entities/relationships to Graph for algorithm execution.
gaps.impact: Cannot run PageRank or community detection on the knowledge graph.

gaps.title: No cross-ontology alignment / mapping
gaps.description: Only AGROVOC concepts supported. No mapping to other agricultural ontologies (CropOntology, Plant Ontology, Soil Ontology, FOODON).
gaps.current_behavior: Single isolated ontology with no external links.
gaps.expected_behavior: SKOS mapping properties (exactMatch, closeMatch, relatedMatch) to external ontologies.
gaps.impact: Cannot integrate data from diverse sources using different semantic standards.

gaps.title: No SPARQL query support
gaps.description: RDF export exists but no SPARQL endpoint or query interface for the ontology.
gaps.current_behavior: Export to rdflib Graph only; no query capability.
gaps.expected_behavior: SPARQL SELECT/CONSTRUCT/ASK support over the ontology graph.
gaps.impact: External tools and researchers cannot query the ontology programmatically.

gaps.title: No OWL reasoning / inference
gaps.description: No subsumption, equivalence, or property chain reasoning. Hierarchy is stored but not inferred.
gaps.current_behavior: Explicit broader/narrower links only; no transitive inference.
gaps.expected_behavior: OWL RL or RDFS reasoning for class subsumption and property inference.
gaps.impact: Cannot infer that a query for 'cereal' should match 'wheat' via hierarchy.

gaps.title: No multilingual label support
gaps.description: Labels are single-language strings. No language tags or multilingual search.
gaps.current_behavior: Plain string labels; search is language-agnostic but not multilingual.
gaps.expected_behavior: Language-tagged literals (e.g., 'Wheat'@en, 'Blé'@fr) with locale-aware search.
gaps.impact: Cannot serve international users or integrate multilingual data sources.

gaps.title: No ontology versioning / provenance
gaps.description: No version tracking, change history, or provenance metadata for concepts.
gaps.current_behavior: Concepts are stateless with no history.
gaps.expected_behavior: Versioned concepts with timestamps, source attribution, and change logs.
gaps.impact: Cannot audit ontology changes or roll back to previous versions.

gaps.title: No sensor data ingestion / IoT integration
gaps.description: No interface for real-time sensor data (soil moisture probes, weather stations, drones) to update the digital twin state.
gaps.current_behavior: Simulation is purely deterministic from initial state.
gaps.expected_behavior: Sensor data adapter with MQTT/WebSocket ingestion and state reconciliation.
gaps.impact: Digital twin cannot reflect actual field conditions — not a real 'twin'.

gaps.title: No event-driven simulation / discrete event support
gaps.description: Simulation advances in fixed daily steps. No event queue for irrigation, fertilization, pest outbreaks, or harvest.
gaps.current_behavior: Fixed-step loop with no event injection.
gaps.expected_behavior: Discrete event simulation with priority queue and event handlers.
gaps.impact: Cannot model management interventions or unexpected events.

gaps.title: No WebSocket / streaming output
gaps.description: No push mechanism for simulation results or state updates to external consumers.
gaps.current_behavior: Synchronous batch simulation only.
gaps.expected_behavior: Streaming simulation updates via WebSocket or SSE for live dashboards.
gaps.impact: Cannot power real-time monitoring dashboards or alerting systems.

gaps.title: No knowledge graph ↔ simulator synchronization
gaps.description: Knowledge graph and simulator are completely decoupled. Graph entities don't drive simulation parameters or vice versa.
gaps.current_behavior: Two isolated modules with no data flow between them.
gaps.expected_behavior: Bidirectional sync: graph entities parameterize simulation; simulation results update graph properties.
gaps.impact: Cannot use the graph to configure scenarios or persist results back.

gaps.title: No ontology ↔ knowledge graph concept linking
gaps.description: No mechanism to link knowledge graph entities to AGROVOC concepts for semantic enrichment.
gaps.current_behavior: Graph entities have no ontology concept references.
gaps.expected_behavior: Entity-to-concept mapping with semantic type annotation.
gaps.impact: Cannot leverage ontology search or reasoning over the knowledge graph.

gaps.title: No persistence / state checkpointing
gaps.description: No save/restore of simulation state or graph snapshots. All state is in-memory and lost on restart.
gaps.current_behavior: to_dict/from_dict exists for graph but no simulator state persistence.
gaps.expected_behavior: State snapshots with timestamped persistence (DB or file) for replay and audit.
gaps.impact: Cannot resume long simulations or analyze historical runs.

gaps.title: No water balance ↔ simulator coupling
gaps.description: water_balance.py and simulator.py both track soil moisture independently. No shared state or feedback loop.
gaps.current_behavior: Two separate moisture models with no data exchange.
gaps.expected_behavior: Water balance model provides moisture to simulator; simulator reports ET demand to water balance.
gaps.impact: Cannot run integrated water-growth simulations.

gaps.title: No nutrient cycling ↔ simulator coupling
gaps.description: nutrient_cycling.py and simulator.py both track nutrient levels independently. No shared state or feedback loop.
gaps.current_behavior: Two separate nutrient models with no data exchange.
gaps.expected_behavior: Nutrient model provides N/P/K to simulator; simulator reports nutrient demand to nutrient model.
gaps.impact: Cannot run integrated nutrient-growth simulations.

gaps.title: No water balance ↔ nutrient cycling coupling
gaps.description: Nutrient leaching in nutrient_cycling.py uses a fixed rate, not driven by water flow from water_balance.py.
gaps.current_behavior: Leaching is independent of actual water drainage.
gaps.expected_behavior: Leaching proportional to drainage volume from water balance model.
gaps.impact: Cannot accurately model nutrient losses under different irrigation regimes.

gaps.title: No unified digital twin orchestrator
gaps.description: No top-level coordinator that ties simulator, knowledge graph, ontology, water balance, nutrient cycling, and graph algorithms together into a cohesive digital twin.
gaps.current_behavior: Package init is empty; modules are independent.
gaps.expected_behavior: DigitalTwin facade that coordinates all subsystems with a unified API.
gaps.impact: Consumers must wire modules manually; no single entry point for the digital twin.

gaps.title: No configuration management
gaps.description: Hardcoded simulation parameters (growth_rate, optimal_temp, max_crop_height). No config file or environment-based tuning.
gaps.current_behavior: Constructor defaults only; no external config.
gaps.expected_behavior: YAML/JSON config with per-crop parameter profiles.
gaps.impact: Cannot adapt to different crops or regions without code changes.

gaps.title: No validation / calibration framework
gaps.description: No mechanism to validate simulation outputs against observed data or calibrate parameters.
gaps.current_behavior: No ground-truth comparison or parameter fitting.
gaps.expected_behavior: Calibration module with RMSE/MAE metrics and parameter optimization.
gaps.impact: Cannot ensure simulation accuracy or improve model fidelity over time.

gaps.title: No logging or observability hooks
gaps.description: Only a module-level logger is defined but never used. No metrics, tracing, or structured logging.
gaps.current_behavior: logger defined but unused; no observability.
gaps.expected_behavior: Structured logging, simulation metrics export, and trace spans.
gaps.impact: Cannot debug production issues or monitor simulation health.

gaps.title: No shared state model across modules
gaps.description: Each module defines its own state dataclass (SimulationState, WaterBalanceState, NutrientState) with overlapping fields (soil_moisture, nutrient_level). No canonical shared state.
gaps.current_behavior: Three independent state models with duplicate/overlapping fields.
gaps.expected_behavior: Unified FarmState or DigitalTwinState that all modules read/write.
gaps.impact: State inconsistencies when modules are used together; no single source of truth.

gaps.title: No event bus integration for digital twin modules
gaps.description: integration/event_bus.py exists but no digital twin module publishes or subscribes to events. Simulation completion, water stress alerts, and nutrient deficiencies are not emitted as domain events.
gaps.current_behavior: Digital twin modules are not connected to the event bus.
gaps.expected_behavior: Modules publish SIMULATION_COMPLETED, WATER_STRESS_ALERT, NUTRIENT_DEFICIENCY events.
gaps.impact: Cannot trigger downstream actions (alerts, recommendations) from simulation results.

gaps.title: No time-series data persistence for simulation results
gaps.description: Simulation history is returned in-memory only. No integration with TimescaleDBStorage or any persistence layer for historical analysis.
gaps.current_behavior: History lists are ephemeral; lost after simulation completes.
gaps.expected_behavior: Automatic persistence of simulation runs to time-series DB for trend analysis and replay.
gaps.impact: Cannot analyze long-term trends or compare multiple simulation runs.

gaps.title: No scenario management / what-if analysis
gaps.description: No mechanism to define, save, and compare multiple simulation scenarios (e.g., different irrigation strategies, fertilizer plans).
gaps.current_behavior: Single simulation run with no scenario comparison.
gaps.expected_behavior: Scenario builder with parameter sweeps, A/B comparison, and sensitivity analysis.
gaps.impact: Cannot systematically evaluate management alternatives.

gaps.title: No API surface / RPC interface
gaps.description: No REST, gRPC, or other API to expose digital twin functionality to external systems or the dashboard.
gaps.current_behavior: No public API; direct Python imports required.
gaps.expected_behavior: REST API or gRPC service for simulation runs, graph queries, and ontology search.
gaps.impact: Cannot integrate with dashboard, mobile apps, or external decision support tools.

gaps.title: No parallel / batch simulation support
gaps.description: No support for running multiple simulations in parallel (e.g., parameter sweeps, Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis).
gaps.current_behavior: Single-threaded sequential simulation only.
gaps.expected_behavior: Parallel execution with multiprocessing or asyncio for batch scenarios.
gaps.impact: Slow exploration of large parameter spaces or uncertainty quantification.

gaps.title: No uncertainty quantification / stochastic modeling
gaps.description: All models are deterministic. No Monte Carlo simulation, parameter uncertainty propagation, or confidence intervals on predictions.
gaps.current_behavior: Point estimates only; no uncertainty bounds.
gaps.expected_behavior: Stochastic weather generation, parameter sampling, and prediction intervals.
gaps.impact: Cannot assess risk or confidence in simulation results.

gaps.title: No digital twin versioning / lineage tracking
gaps.description: No tracking of which model versions, parameters, or input data produced a given simulation result.
gaps.current_behavior: No provenance or lineage metadata.
gaps.expected_behavior: Run ID with model version, parameter hash, and input data reference.
gaps.impact: Cannot reproduce results or audit simulation decisions.
